_help: Levelling and dungeon scaling. xp: experience needed to go from level L to L+1 = base + lin*(L-1) + quad*(L-1)^2 + cube*(L-1)^3 (easy early, steep later). levelUp: points granted per level (attr = attribute points, rank = skill points for the Skills menu, tree = skill tree points). dungeon: monster level = your level + levelOffset + perDepth*(depth-1); bossBonus is added for the boss. gear: the best tier whose depth <= the current depth is worn by every dungeon monster (hpP/dmgP in %, armor/mr flat, lootBonus raises item rarity). upgrades: rolled per monster; count = base + perDepth*(depth-1) (capped at max), bosses get bossExtra more. Upgrade fields: hpP, dmgP, spdP, cdP (attack cooldown %), windP (wind-up %), armor, mr, res {type: %}, onHit {status: chance 0-1}, dmgType, reach (%), xpP and lootBonus.
